featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 独立抽取 13 个能力与治理 Skills，按任务触发加载，并在初始化和升级时按框架保留或裁剪。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Extract 13 focused capability and governance Skills, loaded by task trigger and retained or pruned by framework during initialization and upgrades.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 永久能力策略使用共享锁、旧值核对与原子写入；更新日志预览提供独立只读入口。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Permanent capability preferences use a shared lock, expected-value checks and atomic writes; release-note previews have a dedicated read-only entrypoint.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复保留的升级测试引用下游已裁剪的上游专属清单。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix retained upgrade tests importing an upstream-only manifest that is pruned from downstream projects.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 策略测试使用独立确认夹具，兼容已初始化下游的能力选择和 LF/CRLF 换行，并保持真实策略字节不变。
bugFixes.en-US: Use independent policy test fixtures for initialized downstream preferences and LF/CRLF line endings while preserving the actual policy bytes.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: GPUI 原生开发支持保存后自动重编译并重启，覆盖 Rust、Cargo、词典和静态资源；编译失败后继续监听，编译期间保存会追加构建。
featureOptimizations.en-US: GPUI native development now rebuilds and restarts automatically after Rust, Cargo, locale or static-resource changes; watching continues after compilation errors and saves during a build trigger another build.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 GPUI 根 package.json 的 pnpm dev 入口，新建、追加接口和显式迁移共用脚本合同，并拒绝覆盖冲突的产品脚本。
bugFixes.en-US: Add the missing pnpm dev script to GPUI root package.json; new workspaces, adapter additions and explicit migrations share the same contract and reject conflicting product scripts.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 首次启动及词典/资源变化时刷新所选 GUI 调试缓存，避免旧 build.rs 或过程宏复用过时资源；停止开发会话时清理所拥有的构建和应用进程。
bugFixes.en-US: Invalidate the selected GUI debug cache on first launch and locale/resource changes to avoid stale build-script or procedural-macro resources; clean up owned build and application processes when the development session stops.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 发布后动作、版本、Task 序号和 Core-first 规则收敛为单一权威来源，其余文档只保留指针，并精简 AGENTS.md。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Consolidate post-release, version, task-numbering and core-first rules into single authoritative sources with pointers elsewhere, and slim AGENTS.md.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: GPUI 原生能力补全路由：Tauri 专用 Skill 标明适用范围，设计标准索引与 GUI 路由行指向 GPUI 能力参考，并明确 GPUI 窗口检查的归属。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Complete GPUI routing: mark Tauri-only skills, point the design-standards index and GUI routing row to the GPUI capability references, and name the GPUI window-check owner.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 Rust 模板中过期的 Agent Policy schema v3 引用，并清理已关闭的技术债条目和历史叙述。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix the stale Agent Policy schema v3 reference in the Rust template and remove closed tech-debt entries and historical narration.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 GPUI 原生桌面初始化，提供双语身份、三态主题、系统语言、受限窗口恢复和可选支持页。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add GPUI desktop initialization with bilingual identity, three-state themes, system locale, bounded window restoration, and optional support pages.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: GPUI 按选择接入托盘、通知、自启、单实例和全局快捷键；未启用能力不生成依赖或实现。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Generate optional GPUI tray, notifications, autostart, single-instance activation, and global shortcuts only when selected.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 GPUI 根 pnpm 工程命令，统一验证、Rust 测试、发布和原生打包入口，并安全合并已有配置。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add root pnpm commands for GPUI validation, Rust tests, release workflows, and native packaging, with safe configuration merging.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增独立 GPUI 打包流程和有界后台日志；初始化、升级与发布后动作按 GUI 框架路由。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add separate GPUI packaging and bounded background logging, with framework-aware initialization, upgrades, and post-release actions.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复详细侧栏折叠按钮的位置与点击区域，使其贴合侧栏边界和 Logo 中心。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix the detailed sidebar toggle position and hit area to align with the sidebar boundary and logo center.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复直接退出应用时可能丢失最新窗口位置和尺寸的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve the latest window geometry when quitting the application directly.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 自启开关复读系统实际状态；未达到请求状态时明确反馈失败。
bugFixes.en-US: Report autostart changes as failed when the operating system readback does not match the requested state.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 在任何构建副作用前拒绝开启系统通知的未签名 macOS 候选。
bugFixes.en-US: Reject unsigned macOS candidates with system notifications enabled before any build side effects.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复合法引号框架键被误判为 Tauri，并拒绝重复、错位和表化配置。
bugFixes.en-US: Recognize valid quoted GUI framework keys and reject duplicate, misplaced, or table-shaped configuration.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 Windows 原生 ABI 声明文档，并实际验证生成工程的声明检查器。
bugFixes.en-US: Document Windows native ABI declarations and run the generated workspace through its retained declaration checker.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复推送 release 时遗漏远端默认主分支的问题：默认主分支、release 和 tag 使用同一已发布提交，非强制推送后逐项及联合复读，并支持部分成功后的重试。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix release pushes omitting the remote default branch: synchronize the default branch, release and tag to the same published commit, verify each non-force update and the final set, and support retries after partial success.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 更新当前版本文档和项目状态快照；策略升级校验拒绝仍排除远端默认主分支的旧正文，保留历史版本与验证事实。
bugFixes.en-US: Refresh current version documents and the project status snapshot; policy upgrade validation rejects legacy text that excludes the remote default branch while preserving historical versions and verification facts.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 初始化表单统一使用“程序类型”，展示命令行(CLI)、终端UI(TUI)、MCP、桌面应用(GUI)，保留多选和默认 CLI，并提供既有下游的展示名称升级映射。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Initialization forms now use Program Type with Command Line (CLI), Terminal UI (TUI), MCP, and Desktop Application (GUI), preserving multiple selection and the CLI default, with display-label migration guidance for existing downstream projects.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 no-Python 等连字符门禁名称被误识别为解释器命令的问题；真实解释器与包管理命令仍会被阻断，并增加专项回归覆盖。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent hyphenated gate names such as no-Python from being mistaken for interpreter commands, while retaining real interpreter and package-manager command detection and adding regression coverage.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 同步过期的 Task、Worktree、发布审查范围和策略数量摘要，使现行说明与已实施规则一致；保留仍有效的 ADR 和历史变更记录。
bugFixes.en-US: Align outdated Task, Worktree, release-review scope, and strategy-count summaries with the implemented rules, while preserving effective ADRs and historical change records.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 创建下游项目时自动检查并补装项目本地 taste-skill，适用于全部接口组合，无需询问或全局安装，并保留已有有效本地内容。
featureOptimizations.en-US: New downstream projects automatically check and install project-local taste-skill across all interface combinations, without prompts or global installation, while preserving valid local content.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 内嵌可校验的上游原文、MIT 许可和来源快照，支持离线安装；适用页面可使用其风格指导，并继续遵守既有技术栈和设计标准。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Bundle a verifiable snapshot of the original upstream skill, MIT license, and provenance for offline installation; matching pages can use its style guidance while following existing technology and design standards.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 初始化裁剪后保留独立设计 Skill 及有效使用说明；Harness 升级保护其完整目录，并拒绝自定义规则遮蔽，保留下游定制内容。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Retain the standalone design skill and valid guidance after initialization pruning; Harness upgrades protect its entire directory and reject shadowing custom rules to preserve downstream customizations.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 已有下游可显式选择跟踪 Cargo 与 pnpm 锁文件；受管安装、测试和构建按实际工作区使用冻结解析，默认仍忽略锁文件。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Existing downstream projects can explicitly track Cargo and pnpm lockfiles. Managed install, test, and build steps use frozen resolution for actual workspaces; the default still ignores lockfiles.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复发布流程拒绝精确审查并提交已跟踪 .harness/version-state.json 的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed release commits rejecting a tracked .harness/version-state.json even when it was explicitly reviewed.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复发布后动作选择在混合 CLI/GUI、两种 GUI 布局及独立 Cargo 工作区中漏检 GUI 清单或适用锁文件的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed post-release action selection missing GUI manifests or required lockfiles in mixed CLI/GUI projects, both GUI layouts, and independent Cargo workspaces.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 移除项目锁文件的 Git 跟踪及初始化、候选构建门禁；Harness 与新建下游无需提交 Cargo 或 pnpm 锁文件。
bugFixes.en-US: Removed Git tracking and initialization and candidate build gates for project lockfiles; Harness and new downstream projects no longer require committed Cargo or pnpm lockfiles.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Harness 源完成本地 Git 发布后无法按当次授权推送 release 分支与版本 tag 的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed Harness source releases being unable to push the release branch and version tag after local Git release when explicitly requested.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 旧下游所有权清单仅缺新增 Skill 的显式 managed 规则、且通用规则已授予相同所有权时，升级器现在可生成三方计划并列出修复项；记录基线前仍须补齐清单。
featureOptimizations.en-US: The upgrader now plans against legacy ownership manifests missing a new Skill-specific managed rule when a generic rule already grants the same ownership. It lists the repair and requires the manifest to be fixed before recording a baseline.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复上游 Python 检查器将已发布更新日志中的历史描述误判为活动解释器命令的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed the upstream Python gate misclassifying historical descriptions in published release notes as active interpreter commands.
